item.title: Jersey Zoo launches discounted ticket scheme for those on income support
item.description: JERSEY Zoo has launched a discounted ticket scheme for Islanders on income support. The initiative, which aims to remove the cost barrier to visiting the zoo, offers a £6 ticket for those who can provide proof of actively recieving the benefit. item.title: Planning refuse bid to remove historic petrol pump from Gorey Village home
item.description: PLANS to remove a historic petrol pump from outside a home in Gorey Village have been rejected. Applicant Cherrylyn Seatter asked for planning permission to re-render and paint the outside of the listed 1 Hilgrove Terrace, on the corner of Gorey Village Main Road and Old Road, and also remove its historic green petrol pump. item.description: A LANDMARK UK court ruling on protest laws has “no relevance” to Jersey, the Attorney General has insisted – as he firmly rejected comparisons between the Island’s new public order legislation and controversial measures introduced in England and Wales. item.title: Blanc Pignon Dairy Farm set to close
item.description: ONE of Jersey’s oldest established family dairy farms is ceasing production of all dairy and meat products. Blanc Pignon at La Haule is set to close down, with its herd to be dispersed over time. item.title: Vet treatment for turtle washed up in Storm Goretti nears completion
item.description: AN endangered loggerhead turtle washed up in Jersey during Storm Goretti is continuing to make strong progress, with vets now preparing for the next stage of her recovery. item.title: Phototherapy machine to arrive next month in bid to restart skin service
item.description: THE Island’s 25-year-old phototherapy machine is set to be replaced next month in a bid to restart the dermatology treatment suspended in the pandemic.
